Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in the very first step of the conversation. Instead of starting with a neutral search to identify the actress who played the little girl in the 1947 film *Miracle on 34th Street*, the Planner incorrectly asserted in its "Updated Understanding" that the actress was "Mara Wilson". Mara Wilson played the role in the 1994 remake, not the 1947 original. This incorrect premise led the subsequent steps to search for Mara Wilson's siblings (Anna Wilson) before the Planner corrected itself in the second turn to the correct actress, Natalie Wood.
